\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}
Attention mechanisms have become the dominant approach for sequence
modeling~\cite{vaswani2017attention}. We study their cost.

\subsection{Motivation}\label{sec:motivation}
Quadratic cost limits context length~\cite{child2019sparse}.

\subsection{Contributions}
We propose a cheaper attention variant and evaluate it broadly.

\section{Related Work}\label{sec:related}
Sparse attention~\cite{child2019sparse}, linear attention~\cite{katharopoulos2020linear},
and low-rank projections~\cite{wang2020linformer} all reduce cost.

\input{sections/method}
\input{sections/evaluation}

\section{Conclusion}\label{sec:conclusion}
We presented a cheaper attention mechanism with competitive quality.
